title: Akito'sCore
body:
AkitosCore is the backbone of the Akito's plugin network, providing shared services for all Akito plugins.
Features:

    Shared economy system (custom currency) (planned)
    Player data storage per player (balance, stats, playtime)
    Plugin registry: addons announce themselves to Core
    Auto-save player data on interval and server shutdown

Requirements:

    Paper 1.21.11+
    Java 21+

Installation:

Drop AkitosCore.jar into your plugins folder. All Akito plugins depend on it.
